simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אָנַן (H596) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אָנַן (ʼânan) means to mourn , i.e. complain First listed occurrence: Lam 3 39.

definitions.full: H596. anan [ אָנַן ] verb only Hithpo`el complain, murmur (Mishna אֶנן , Aramaic אֲנַן , Arabic , Assyrian [ anânu ], whence ênênu , unnînu , sigh Zim BP 22 ) — Imperfect יִתְאוֺנֵן Lam 3:39 (followed by עַלֿ in || member); Participle י ׳בְּאָזְנֵי מִתְאֹנְנִים (followed by accusative; see Di).
